mods.name: Isotope
mods.description: Runs Fabric mods built for a different Minecraft 26.x version. Rewrites their bytecode, mixins and metadata to match the game you are running, and tells you up front what could not be bridged.

releases.notes:
Put this jar in your normal `mods` folder, and mods built for another Minecraft 26.x version in `<game>/isotope/mods`.

**Changes in 1.0.1**
- The Lost Castle loads on 26.3: a lambda for a game interface that no longer declares its method is no longer reported as a crash.
- Lenient mixin mode: an `@Inject` hook whose target method changed its parameters is now switched off cleanly and reported. Before, the leftover handler could break the whole game class it targeted (seen with Moonlight on 26.3).

Tested on 26.3 and 26.2 dedicated servers with 33 real mods (results: https://ophidianp.github.io/isotope/compatibility.html). Not tested on a client yet.
